feedback.problem: Find the largest interval of continuity for the function $f(x)={log}_{5}⁡(9-x).$
feedback.worked_solution:
The logarithmic function ${log}_{2}⁡(9-x)$ is continuous at all points in its domain. However, the logarithm is only defined for positive inputs, so to find its domain, we set the expression inside the logarithm to be greater than zero:

$$
9-x>0\,⟹\,x<9
$$

Therefore, the function $f(x)=\operatorname{log}⁡(9-x)$ is continuous on the interval $(-\infty ,9).$
